messages.subject: problem with geom_boxplot and coord_flip

# doesn't work

Error in inherits(unit, "unit") : object 'xmin' not found

You are right; it is a bug in plyr 1.5. I submitted a bug report on it.
https://github.com/hadley/plyr/issues/38

This bug may also affect the use of "base" aesthetic names, American
spellings of aesthetics, coord_flipped, coord_polar, geom_segment,
stat_density, and stat_summary. All those features use rename, and
might get the internal names of things mixed up leading to errors or
inaccuracies.
